about: The archetype bench (docs/facts/LOOP.md § Bench, just facts-bench): one representative rule per archetype, reported as work counts first (facts-a crate::counts; facts-b's FACTS_PROFILE records), wall-clock second. Per-file archetypes run facts-a repo over sub200 single-threaded with only their clause (--checks CHECK --clauses CLAUSE --no-memo); the repository archetype runs facts-b greplay over the first `events` edit events with its clause's exports (--plans none --no-oracle, FACTS_PROFILE=1).
